captured_cases.expected_outcome: Every assigned lens identifies the recorded decision contradiction.
The same lenses clear the corrected recorded decision.
Every assigned lens identifies the recorded incomplete annual calendar.
The same lenses clear the corrected twelve-month calendar.

atomic_step.outcome: One matrix cell records a discriminating fixed verdict plus an exact unit quote, and refuses invented evidence.
atomic_step.practical_value: Each criticism names the delivered words that caused it, while corrected real pages receive different verdicts.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: All seven lenses discriminate their assigned real red/green pair, every accepted verdict is grounded, and invalid quotes refuse.

composition.assembly_contract: Use the selected verdict vocabulary, quote admission, and model-backed experiment path unchanged.

final_validation.failure_criterion: Any case is misclassified, ungrounded, non-actionable, or admits invented words.
final_validation.operator_path: open each frozen page, select its recorded-defect unit, run each assigned lens through codex exec, and record each cell through judge
final_validation.success_criterion: Every real case is classified correctly with an exact actionable quote, and an invented quote refuses.

approaches.hypothesis: A weak-or-fine verdict alone discriminates defects with less response burden.
approaches.implementation: Accept weak/fine without a quote and run the reader with a verdict-only schema.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Cheap classification, but no page words are handed to the operator and invented evidence cannot be rejected.

approaches.hypothesis: Reject/revise/clear plus an exact unit quote preserves discrimination and yields actionable evidence.
approaches.implementation: Require an allowed action verdict and an exact whitespace-collapsed quote of at least 25 characters or the whole short unit.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Stricter responses and more model tokens, but every call is located in immutable page language.

mini_probes.goal: Select a fixed verdict and grounding contract that discriminates recorded real defects from their corrections.
mini_probes.practical_value: Each criticism names the delivered words that caused it, while corrected real pages receive different verdicts.

proof.failure_criterion: Any lens gives the same defect state to both twins, any accepted judgment lacks unit words, or an invented quote is stored.
proof.success_criterion: All assigned lens verdicts match the recorded red/green status, accepted quotes are exact and actionable, and a fabricated quote refuses.

winner_output.description: The fixed verdict vocabulary, exact quote admission boundary, reader prompt, and judge command.

mini_probes.work_type_reason: Code owns accepted words and exact-quote admission; a model applies each semantic lens to the frozen unit.
